segments.text: Pakistan versus Turkey. Four rounds. Who wins?
People. Pakistan has almost three times as many.
Economy. Turkey is almost four times bigger.
Life expectancy. Turkey wins by almost ten years.
Land. Pakistan wins by just twelve hundred fifty square kilometers.
